about: T-519 item 1 (DRAFT): SPIRITS' tone on the follower and the party icons. By DEBUG's WATCH at day, the lead walks behind the player as it is, then in good spirits (lighter, 10/32 of the way to white over its own colours) and in low spirits (darker, 10/32 to black) -- set by hand through DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> SPIRITS, each crossing played out on the next step. Then the creator's hour at full (DEBUG TIME 4:48) over the low-spirited follower: its gold goes on after the tone. Then the party menu with one daemon in each state: the lead in good spirits, slot 2 in low (the low lead swapped down), the rest as they are. The icons share a palette per colour group, so a toned one is pointed at a toned copy of its group's palette (one per group and tone). The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's; nothing is saved and TIME is put back at the end.

steps: burst "the follower as it is: its own colours" 1 1

stops.stop: The follower in good spirits: lighter
steps: burst "the follower in good spirits: lighter over the same colours" 1 1

stops.stop: The follower in low spirits: darker
steps: burst "the follower in low spirits: darker over the same colours" 1 1

stops.stop: Low spirits under the creator's hour: the gold over the tone (DEBUG TIME 4:48)
steps: burst "the creator's hour's gold on the low-spirited follower" 1 1
burst "the hour gone: low spirits by day again" 1 1

stops.stop: The party menu: the lead in good spirits, slot 2 in low, the rest as they are
steps: burst "the party: slot 1 lighter, slot 2 darker, the rest their own" 1 1
